text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day at noon. While having lunch
with Cheval Grand—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Craaash!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: A-Are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The area around the counter suddenly grew noisy.
Wondering what was going on, I took a look...

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
Ow, ow, ow... I-I threw my back out...
And we're already so shorthanded as it is...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it, ma'am, just take a rest!
We'll take care of it for you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Please leave today's lunch rush to us♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fried shrimp set meal, coming right up♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Three bowls of ramen, thanks for waiting!
And who had the carrot hamburger steak?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black and Satono Diamond are working
hard to help out at the café, somehow managing
to cover for the lady's absence.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, no, um... thank you for the meal.
I-I'll be taking my leave now, so
please, take your time eating...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She hurriedly gets up from her seat and, for some reason,
walks over to the corner of the cafe.
Curious, I go over to check on her after eating—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was tidying up the overflowing trash can.
Kitasan Black and the others seemed to have their hands full at the counter and couldn't keep up with the cleaning.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh— Ah...
W-Well then, next I'll wipe down the tables...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two of us silently
took out trash, wiped down surfaces, and swept over and over—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... Looks like the lunch rush is over, huh?
I'm glad we managed to pull through, Kita-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah—wait, huh?
Cheval-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, you're cleaning up the trash!!
You were helping out!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I completely forgot about cleaning up...!
Wow, every single table is spotless...!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... u-um...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Cheval-chan!
You've been backing me up this whole time, haven't you~!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-san, you're really so thoughtful and attentive!
Running the cafe smoothly was all thanks to you...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Dia
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Cheval-chan!!
Amazing, Cheval-san!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... U-Um... N-No...
I don't need... any thanks...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Y-You too, Trainer-san...!?
U-Um... well...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I-I-I-I'll,
go throw this trash aw—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crash, THUD! Flump!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you alright!?
Cheval-chan, are you hurt or—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaah, I'm sorry, I'm so sorry!!
I-It's such a mess... Auu...
choice_data_list: There's no need for you to apologize.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand's achievements are undeniably
fantastic, but even when she has her clumsy moments,
I still find them rather endearing.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I love when Cheval-chan is cool,
and I love when she's a little clumsy, too!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Flaws, strengths, and everything in between—Cheval-san is a dear friend I truly love!
choice_data_list: So there's no need to apologize.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Ah... Uuuh...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!!
Cheval-chan has gone flat-out punk!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
H-Haah... in... h-hale... ex... hale...
Inhhhhale... exhhhaaale...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry... I-I got flustered...
Um, I know it was just flattery...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh, it's not flattery at all, okay!?
Everything I said is true!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "We truly do respect you, Cheval-san. Having those feelings brushed aside makes us feel a little lonely."
choice_data_list: Cheval's thoughtfulness really is one of her greatest virtues.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Ah.........
M-My... strong point..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—Um...
...Thank... you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Dia
text_block_list.text: ――! Yeah!
